description: Pre-publication semantic content features for TikTok Shop videos. Descriptive only: no outcome, engagement or sales information is used or extracted.

hook_type.definition: Dominant attention device in the first 3 seconds (spoken, on-screen text, or visual).

content_format.definition: Overall structure of the whole video.

primary_mode.definition: More than 60% of runtime showing product use/action (demonstration) vs the creator talking; otherwise balanced.

product_demo.definition: The product is visibly used for its function (not just held up). not_applicable = no product shown at all.

problem_solution.definition: A specific problem or pain point is stated, then the product is presented as the fix.

transformation.definition: Before/after or results: claimed = only said or written; shown = both states visibly shown.

creator_on_camera.definition: Highest level of creator visibility at any point in the video.

product_visibility.definition: brief = product in frame for under about 25% of runtime; prominent = in frame for most of the video.

product_in_first_3s.definition: Product visible within the first 3 seconds.

cta_strength.definition: soft = recommend/check it out; direct = explicit buying pointer (link, orange cart, tap, buy, get yours). Spoken, on-screen, or in the caption.

urgency_scarcity.definition: Time pressure (sale ends, Black Friday deadline) or limited stock (only a few left). Pick the strongest if both.

social_proof.definition: creator_testimonial = the creator's own experience over time; third_party = reviews, ratings, number sold, or other people's results.

humor.definition: The video is intended to be funny (joke, skit, comedic exaggeration), not merely upbeat.

text_overlay.definition: minimal = one short label; substantial = headline/hook text, multiple lines, or burned-in captions.
